texts.orig: In this section we will analyze the finite-time stability for IQVIPs (1.1). By doing so we propose a new first order dynamical system associated with the problem (1.1) such that a solution of (1.1) becomes an equilibrium point of the dynamical system. Under mild conditions for the parameters, we demonstrate that the proposed dynamical system is finite-time stable.
texts.text: In this section we will analyze the finite-time stability for IQVIPs (1.1). By doing so we propose a new first order dynamical system associated with the problem (1.1) such that a solution of (1.1) becomes an equilibrium point of the dynamical system. Under mild conditions for the parameters, we demonstrate that the proposed dynamical system is finite-time stable.
